story.title: Noyb challenges LinkedIn's GDPR practice of selling profile visitor data back to users as a premium feature
story.summary: European privacy advocacy group Noyb has filed a complaint arguing that LinkedIn violates GDPR Article 15 by processing users' profile visitor data and then charging them a premium subscription fee to access their own information. The complaint contends that under GDPR, individuals have a right to access data about themselves free of charge, making LinkedIn's monetisation model for this feature legally questionable. If upheld, the ruling could set a significant precedent affecting how any EU-regulated platform handles processed user data.
